description: This file defines the CartActivity class, which manages the shopping cart UI in an Android app. It handles displaying cart items, swipe-to-delete with undo, updating quantities, clearing cart, and proceeding to checkout.

classes.name: CartActivity
classes.description: Main activity managing the shopping cart UI, including interactions, swipe gestures, and navigation.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Sets up the activity, initializes viewmodel, UI components, and binds state.

methods.name: setupToolbar
methods.description: Configures the toolbar with title and navigation.

methods.name: setupRecycler
methods.description: Initializes RecyclerView with adapter, layout manager, and swipe-to-delete behavior.

methods.name: attachSwipeToDelete
methods.description: Attaches item touch helper for swipe-to-delete with undo functionality.

methods.name: setupActions
methods.description: Configures button click actions for clear cart, checkout, and browse.

methods.name: onActivityResult
methods.description: Handles result from checkout activity, shows confirmation snackbar.

methods.name: bindState
methods.description: Binds viewmodel state flows to UI updates.

methods.name: bindErrorsAndIdentity
methods.description: Manages identity prompt and error display logic.

methods.name: announceForA11y
methods.description: Helper to announce messages for accessibility.

methods.name: onOptionsItemSelected
methods.description: Handles toolbar menu item clicks, e.g., back button.
